title: Home Sleep Tests
subtitle: What home sleep tests measures, how to interpret it, limitations, and when it is clinically useful.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the use of home sleep tests for diagnosing moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea in selected patient populations, with numerous clinical guidelines endorsing their application. Moderate evidence exists regarding emerging applications such as telemedicine integration. Limitations and reduced sensitivity for mild or central apnea are also well documented.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
